subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
intent: a required figure is either measured or explicitly declared unavailable — never silently absent
fit_criterion: zero missing-figure discrepancies across the batch, counted by FR-15's reconciliation against each harness's enumerated required-figure set (FR-14). The count comes from the reconciliation, **not** from EVT-2 alone: EVT-2 fires only when an unavailability is successfully declared, so a silently dropped figure would emit nothing and pass unseen
